arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Taranto argued the money suit is outside ERISA's equitable relief section.
Mr. Wolfson stated this is the only mechanism to enforce a plan term.
Mr. Wolfson characterized this enforcement as equitable relief under ERISA.
